## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`…) — it becomes the changelog entry
- [ ] `bun run check-types` and `bun run test` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] Docs updated for user-facing changes (`docs/`, `README.md`)
- [ ] Database changes include a generated migration
- [ ] Works with right-to-left catalogs, if it touches layout or text
- [ ] Screenshots attached for UI changes
